dossier.scp_unleashed.346.title: Small Winged Reptiles
dossier.scp_unleashed.346.caption: Four SCP-346 instances around the aviary log, shortly after intake. None of them would face the camera.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-346 instances are kept in an open-roofed aviary with perches at several heights, a sand floor and a shallow water tray. Instances that wander out are to be coaxed back, never chased.
Feeding is twice daily. Instances take fish readily and show little interest in anything else.
**Instances are not to be handled roughly.** A frightened flock scatters into the air and can take some time to settle again.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-346 is a group of small winged reptiles of unknown origin, each about the size of a large songbird. Each has a long, slender, sharply pointed beak, small dark eyes set well back on the head and a coat of soft down, shaggiest on the throat and chest.

Their wings are thin leathery membranes stretched along a long finger. On the ground the wings fold tight against the body, and the instances walk on their feet and folded wing knuckles with a rolling waddle.
Instances differ in colour: ash grey, smoky brown, sooty black, sandy tan, rusty russet and pale cream have all been seen. Colouring does not appear to affect behaviour.

SCP-346 is gentle and harmless. Instances keep to a loose flock, fly short loops, perch on rails, fences and branches, and roost together at night with their heads tucked back. They chirr softly to one another and clack their beaks when pleased.
Some instances have grown attached to particular members of staff. %rThe reason is still being studied.%r

page.title: Addendum 346-1: Arrival
page.text: SCP-346 has no recovery record. The first flock of four flew in out of open sky a short while after a researcher read this file, circled once and settled on the ground nearby. Flocks have arrived the same way since.

page.title: Addendum 346-2: Field Note
page.text: They startle easily and calm down just as easily. Sit still, keep your hands low and let them come to you. They will, eventually, mostly to see whether you brought anything to eat.

SCP-346: small winged reptiles of unknown origin, about the size of a bird, with soft downy fuzz, long slender beaks and leathery wings. They come in %s colourings.
Spawns one SCP-346 instance in a random colouring. Each has %s health, does not despawn and never attacks anything.
They keep to a loose flock, perch wherever they can and roost together at night. Startle one and the rest take to the air. They seem very fond of fish.
They never appear on their own. Read the SCP-346 dossier at an Archive Terminal. Operators can also use /scp_unleashed scp346 flock.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp346.0: Watch the open sky. They come as a flock.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp346.1: Gentle, curious and fond of fish.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp346.2: Never chase them. They come back.
